description: mod-eusage-reports configuration template. Resource, JVM and replica defaults follow the Trillium Bugfest configuration details at https://folio-org.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/REL/pages/1034125338, for the reference baseline of 3 standalone tenants and 11 consortia tenants. The FSE real-values column is empty; the table does not establish CPU, gateway timeout or environment-variable defaults. Those recommendations remain provisional or descriptor-derived, except JAVA_OPTIONS which reflects the published JVM baseline. Null environment values must be supplied by the deployment. The empty sidecarDefaults block is required by DeployConfigSchema.ts and does not prescribe sidecar settings.

resources.name: cpu
resources.description: Provisional CPU units from the authoring guide fallback; no module-specific Bugfest allocation was found.

resources.name: memory
resources.description: Container memory hard limit in MiB from the Trillium Bugfest baseline.

resources.name: memoryReservation
resources.description: Container memory reservation in MiB from the Trillium Bugfest baseline.

java.name: xmx
java.description: Maximum Java heap size from the Trillium Bugfest baseline.

java.name: MaxMetaspaceSize
java.description: Maximum Java metaspace size from the Trillium Bugfest baseline.

deployment.description: Two running instances match the Trillium Bugfest baseline; validate concurrent report ingestion and replica sizing against the deployment workload.

kong.description: Provisional gateway timeouts, allowing longer reads for report generation and downstream requests; increase read timeout if measured processing times exceed 120 seconds.

EnvVars.name: JAVA_OPTIONS
EnvVars.description: JVM options passed by the container launcher, matching the Trillium Bugfest heap and metaspace limits documented in the java section.

EnvVars.name: DB_HOST
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL hostname supplied by the deployment instead of the descriptor's local postgres hostname.

EnvVars.name: DB_PORT
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL port, retaining the ModuleDescriptor default.

EnvVars.name: DB_USERNAME
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL administrative username supplied by the deployment for tenant schema management.

EnvVars.name: DB_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL password supplied through deployment secret management instead of the descriptor's development credential.

EnvVars.name: DB_DATABASE
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL database containing tenant schemas, supplied by the deployment instead of the descriptor's okapi_modules database.

EnvVars.name: DB_QUERYTIMEOUT
EnvVars.description: Legacy descriptor query timeout in milliseconds, retained for compatibility but not consumed by vertx-lib 4.1.1 TenantPgPool.

EnvVars.name: DB_CHARSET
EnvVars.description: Legacy descriptor database character encoding, retained for compatibility but not consumed by vertx-lib 4.1.1 TenantPgPool.

EnvVars.name: DB_MAXPOOLSIZE
EnvVars.description: Maximum PostgreSQL pool connections per tenant per module instance, retaining the ModuleDescriptor default.
